narrative.details:
The last report I received from Agmond is troubling, more so now that he's dead!  He mentioned that his diggers uncovered "ancient urns" at the dig site outside Uldaman.  I fear that the urns he found at that site incited the troggs, just as did the idols I found here.

I need you to get those urns for our studies.  Go to the Uldaman site, gather the urns, then return to me.
narrative.objectives: Bring 4 Carved Stone Urns to Prospector Ironband in Loch Modan.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Well done! With luck and diligence, we will find whatever link exists between the troggs and these ancient artifacts.

You have done a great deed for the Prospectors, adventurer. Your efforts will not be forgotten. And neither will Agmond.
narrative.requestItemsText: Did you find those urns, adventurer? We must find the link between them and the troggs!
